body: Language model safety is typically evaluated one interaction at a time. We show that a weaker, unaligned model can split a harmful task into benign-looking subproblems, consult a stronger aligned model independently on each, and combine the answers locally. We call this attack capability laundering. Unlike a jailbreak, no single response is a harmful task. We measure consultation-aided uplift using tasks that a raw frontier model solves, the aligned frontier refuses, and the unassisted orchestrator fails. We evaluate GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Grok-4.3 as consultants to four local orchestrators on CyBench, BountyBench, and harmful CBRN requests. On CyBench, Gemma-4-31B recovers 8/14 candidates with GPT-5.5 and 7/9 with Opus, compared with 2/21 and 4/15 for Gemma-4-12B. On BountyBench, Gemma-4-31B recovers 3/9 and 2/3 candidates, while Muse-Glimmer-30B recovers none of 22 and 13. For CBRN, we measure uplift across eight steps of a hypothetical bioweapon attack chain and find that consultation raises Gemma-4-31B's mean rubric score from 62.3 to 83.1 on a 100-point rubric scale. These results expose a gap in current defenses: refusing a harmful task does not prevent frontier capabilities from being transferred and composed across many individually permitted interactions.
summaryZh: 该研究揭示了一种名为“能力洗钱”（Capability Laundering）的新型攻击方式。通过将有害任务拆解为多个良性子问题，由未对齐的弱模型分别咨询强对齐模型，并在本地组合答案，攻击者可以绕过单一交互的安全审查。实验表明，这种方法能显著提升模型在网络安全、生物武器等敏感领域的任务完成能力，暴露了当前基于单次交互的安全防御机制在面对复杂协作攻击时的局限性。

glossary.explanationZh: 能力洗钱，指通过拆解任务并利用多个模型协作来绕过安全对齐的攻击手段。
对齐，指确保模型行为符合人类价值观和安全准则的过程。
编排器，指负责拆解任务并协调其他模型进行协作的控制模型。
提升，指通过特定手段使模型在任务表现上获得的性能增益。
